title: Mukesh Kumar v. State of U.P.
headnote: Not a Supply Code case — a bail application in a dowry-death case under IPC ss.304-B/498-A read with Dowry Prohibition Act ss.3/4, granted on the ground that the co-accused (applicant's sister-in-law) had already been enlarged on bail and only general dowry-demand allegations were made against the applicant. No electricity-related content appears anywhere in the order.
